windows.tr-all-unchecked: - { name: tr7, operation: [{rotate_around_x: 30}, {rotate_around_y: -45.5}, {rotate_around_z: 90}, {rotate_by_axis_angle: {axis: 1 2 3, angle: 60}}, {rotate_by_matrix: {row_1: 0 -1 0, row_2: 1 0 0, row_3: 0 0 1}}, {translate: 10 -20 3.5e2}, {rotate_by_rpy: 1 2 3}, {rotate_by_eulerzxz: 4 5 6}, {rotate_by_eulerxyz: 7 8 9}] }
windows.tr-all-checked:
- name: tr7
    operation:
      - rotate_around_x: 30
      - rotate_around_y: -45.5
      - rotate_around_z: 90
      - rotate_by_axis_angle:
          axis: 1 2 3
          angle: 60
      - rotate_by_matrix:
          row_1: 0 -1 0
          row_2: 1 0 0
          row_3: 0 0 1
      - translate: 10 -20 3.5e2
      - rotate_by_rpy: 1 2 3
      - rotate_by_eulerzxz: 4 5 6
      - rotate_by_eulerxyz: 7 8 9
windows.tr-all-indeterminate:
- name: tr7
    operation:
      - rotate_around_x: 30
      - rotate_around_y: -45.5
      - rotate_around_z: 90
      - rotate_by_axis_angle: {axis: 1 2 3, angle: 60}
      - rotate_by_matrix: {row_1: 0 -1 0, row_2: 1 0 0, row_3: 0 0 1}
      - translate: 10 -20 3.5e2
      - rotate_by_rpy: 1 2 3
      - rotate_by_eulerzxz: 4 5 6
      - rotate_by_eulerxyz: 7 8 9
